findings.problem: Unique labels do not establish that an initially root-owned native local volume is writable by workerUID1000. Mount ownership/no-copy/bootstrap/ownership-mismatch behavior is unspecified.
findings.required_guard: Create new entropy-named local volume and verify ownerlabel/name/driver/emptyinventory; use volume-nocopy. One bounded isolated bootstrap helper may set only this new empty volume root to1000:1000/mode0700, then exit. Nonroot actualwrite/read/fsync probe before sample; mismatched/nonempty/borrowed volume or bootstrap failure stops. Keep helper/image/mount/exit receipts and restrict cleanup to exactownedobject.

findings.problem: Separate input accounting and combined native/export/archive allowance lack one numeric peak-footprint equation and proven actualDocker backing-disk relationship. C-host free alone or thin-provisioned native statfs cannot establish physical headroom.
findings.required_guard: Freeze input-size bound and global ledger: newly retained input snapshot copies +nativeoutputs+hoststaging/export+archive+temporary/logs/progress/pinreceipts <=declared total (or explicit preregistered input exclusion with separate bound). Reserve each copy peak before write; count simultaneous duplicates, use conservative archive bound. Verify actual Cfilesystem and Docker VM/VHD backing filesystem, fresh space on each with explicit reserves. Unknown/stale/low rejects before creation/export. Final32GiB cap cannot be inferred to fit current~27.6GB free.

findings.problem: Heartbeat age/clock-skew handling, external supervision and stop/export/cleanup deadlines are not fixed. A blockedNode loop cannot guarantee its own10s heartbeat or terminate itself.
findings.required_guard: Freeze external monotonic workerdeadline300000ms plus setup/stop/export/cleanup bounds and escalationgrace. Owner-bound sequence+age heartbeat with future/skew/stale rejection; external supervisor checks host/nativeguards independently of workerloop. Terminate only ownedworker, preserve failures/prefix; unfinished export/retainedvolume reportedNOT_ACCEPTED/NOT_CLEANED rather than cleanupPASS. Separate processCPU/cgroupCPU/host overhead and nested timers; never sum overlap or change logicalscriptclock.

followup_root_128MiB: New bounded diagnostic cap may be preregistered by root; not present in fixed proposal03 which says20MiB. Both require explicit combined-footprint accounting; final32GiB unaffected.
